source_scope: Incremental checkpoint save/load, real mutation sites, transactional legacy materialization and Suite switch ordering; no source edits by this reviewer.

findings_addressed.issue: Parent subagent receipts hid a full deep-copy/serialization of child history at each boundary.
findings_addressed.resolution: Internal subagent receipts share canonical child history; persistence shallow-copies small record state and blocks large receipt fields. The actual 32-read synchronous-child regression checks source identity, row counts and the exact reconstructed snapshot.

findings_addressed.issue: Retired streams/sessions were retained by strong-reference cache and stale block rows.
findings_addressed.resolution: Each committed batch prunes unused current-session streams; successful session archiving releases that session memory cache; store close clears caches. The actual max_sessions=1 test creates and closes 4 sessions and reads archived history.

findings_addressed.issue: Initial DDL committed before schema marker update, leaving new version0 database unreopenable after an intervening failure.
findings_addressed.resolution: Schema3/4 assignment now commits inside the existing DDL transaction.

findings_addressed.issue: Legacy conversion materialized all historical session trees at once and rewrote already-full checkpoints.
findings_addressed.resolution: Verified rows are processed one at a time; only block-manifest heads convert; existing full heads/journal remain unchanged. Schema3 exit is a no-op. Mixed-format actual SQLite test verifies exact old head/journal preservation.

findings_addressed.issue: Negative-step list assignment marked the wrong suffix.
findings_addressed.resolution: Dirty position uses minimum affected index; real materialize roundtrip test includes reverse slice assignment.

checks: Only host BlockReference instances become manifest leaves; arbitrary user JSON keys cannot become references.
Changed suffix items are encoded before envelope serialization; unchanged canonical message/receipt bodies are not fully snapshotted before splitting.
Actual message/receipt entries are stable after append: backend construction and Hybrid projection copies receive mutations; canonical originals are read-only in inspected paths.
Queue handling at recorded-receipt boundary and existing restore_runtime semantic/recovery paths remain intact.
Manifest, changed block rows, intent/receipt state, journal revision and schema4 commit in one existing transaction.
Legacy conversion verifies block order, item digests, chained heads and counts; appends legacy_materialized revision instead of overwriting old journal evidence; sets3 and removes blocks atomically.
Suite executes current Core helper only after services stop, before applicable wheel/Channels/APP switching; failed conversion prevents switching and never restores an old backup.

reviewed_executed_evidence.targeted: rc20-runtime/incremental-r3.log: 121 run, 121 passed, 20.082 seconds; includes 7 new incremental tests.
reviewed_executed_evidence.crash: Actual apply_patch writes ONCE, then receipt commit fails; actual RC18 rejects schema 4; candidate helper converts; actual RC18 preserves UNKNOWN_BLOCKED and denies continue with 0 provider requests, unchanged file mtime and original journal rows.
reviewed_executed_evidence.measurement_harness: The exact RC19 96-read input, budgets, fixture contents and model configuration are preserved. The diff adds only write counters and normal-stop/export timing.

remaining_scope_limits: No new paid model calls, physical GUI acceptance or full-suite claim from this review.
serialized_bytes counts JSON payload bytes submitted to checkpoint/block rows, not physical WAL or disk bytes.
Cold restore still materializes complete active session state before existing restore_runtime; this does not establish bounded startup RAM.
Public snapshots, archive creation and explicit old-format conversion intentionally materialize full session data; TaskRecord final result capture still has a real completion-boundary cost.
The 96-read timing is one observed run, not a statistical performance or 1,000-receipt guarantee.
